desktop.notesZh:
批次十七（splash 慢启动提示并入旋转状态行 + 确认门横向三选项卡 + 门禁明细去灰亮面 + 测试流卡片三改与一键开关）
① splash：批次十六的左下角单行慢启动条显示异常，整条撤销——5 秒后「首次启动耗时较久，请耐心等待」直接插入顶部旋转状态行（与「正在检查更新…」等轮流播报，零布局位移），「后台启动」按钮单独绝对定位在面板左下角（与右上角版本号呼应，5 秒前不可点）。② 确认门流程图改版：「需求进入」更名「需求输入」并升级为品牌色渐变醒目输入框；删除「工作区未初始化·先行」「按进行中的变更三选一（互斥）」文字标签与虚线汇流轨，三个互斥选项改为横向一排选项卡（未发现进行中的工作流/已有进行中的变更/多条未完成的变更，请选择接手对象），进入条件（无进行中的变更等）直接印在选项卡上；选项卡本身就是确认门节点，点击即在右侧打开该门专属明细。③ 门禁明细：门卡去灰底改亮色浮面 + 警示色左条；状态节点明细不再显示确认门数量与「确认门」小节（确认门只在门节点上）；右侧明细 sticky 置顶，随滚动常驻可视区。④ 测试流卡片：标题与前置卡之间留出间距不再叠靠；构建/测试/报告目录按钮去除浏览器默认黑边；「启用」「失败中止」开关改小号尺寸（28×16）更精致；前置 00 卡新增「测试流开关」一键启停整个测试流（客户端按依赖闭包逐独立根 RPC 翻转，服务端级联为唯一事实源，八步同启同停）。⑤ 溯源确认：C 代码规范 P1.6 明确注释/Doxygen 为软约束、注释率与 doxygen warn 不进 CI（P2 另议），测试流无 doxygen 步骤属文档既定设计；docs-doxygen/docs-open 指令在本仓库无实现（bafplugin 时代遗留引用）。六个页签顶部首元素距页签条实测统一 14px，无需改动。
desktop.notesEn:
Batch seventeen (splash hint joins the rotating status line + gates three-way option cards in one row + de-grayed gate details + test-flow card fixes with a master switch)
(1) Splash: the batch-sixteen bottom-left slow-launch row displayed broken and is retired — after 5s the hint 「首次启动耗时较久，请耐心等待」 splices into the rotating status line (taking its turn with 正在检查更新…, zero layout shift) and the 后台启动 button pins alone to the panel bottom-left (mirroring the top-left version, unclickable before 5s). (2) Gates flow redesign: 需求进入 renamed 需求输入 as a prominent brand-gradient entry box; the 「工作区未初始化·先行」/「按进行中的变更三选一（互斥）」 labels and the dashed rail are deleted — the three mutually exclusive options become ONE horizontal row of option cards (no active workflow / one change in progress / multiple unfinished changes, pick one to take over) with the entry condition printed on each card; each option card IS its confirm-gate node and clicking it opens that gate’s own detail on the right. (3) Details: gate cards drop the gray wash for a bright elevated surface with a warning left bar; state-node details no longer show a confirm-gate count or a 确认门 section (gates live on the gate nodes only); the right-hand details panel is sticky and stays visible while scrolling. (4) Test-flow card: real spacing between the card title and the 前置 card; the build/test/report directory buttons lose the browser default black border; 启用/失败中止 switches shrink to a small size (28×16); the 00 prereq card gains a test-flow master switch that toggles all eight stages at once (client flips each independent root over RPC by dependency closure; the server cascade stays the single source of truth). (5) Sourcing: the C code standard P1.6 keeps comments/Doxygen a soft constraint — comment rate and doxygen warnings stay out of CI (deferred to P2), so the test flow has no doxygen step by documented design; the docs-doxygen/docs-open commands have no implementation in this repo (bafplugin-era legacy references). All six tabs measure a uniform 14px from the tab strip to the first element — verified, no change needed.
